translationRepairs: The officials requested that Henan be assigned to Jizhou and Hedong to Bingzhou.
The officials requested that Henei be assigned to Jizhou and Hedong to Bingzhou.
Source 河內 is the Henei commandery; Henan would be 河南, so the idiomatic place name must be corrected to Henei.
Officials requested Henan belong to Jizhou, Hedong belong to Bingzhou.
Officials requested Henei belong to Jizhou, Hedong belong to Bingzhou.
Source 河內 is Henei; the literal's Henan does not match the Chinese place name.
Moved Sefu rich people to Yunling, granted money, households one hundred thousand.
Moved Three Adjuncts rich people to Yunling, granted money, households one hundred thousand.
Source 三輔 is the Three Adjuncts; Sefu is a corrupted mistranslation with no basis in the Chinese.

Initially, Shangguan Jie and his son An contended for power with Grand General Huo Guang and wished to harm him. They falsely had someone submit a memorial to King Dan of Yan accusing Guang of crimes.

Initially, Shangguan Jie and his son An contended for power with Grand General Huo Guang and wished to harm him. They falsely had someone submit a memorial in the name of King Dan of Yan accusing Guang of crimes.
為燕王旦上書 means submitting a memorial as/for King Dan of Yan, not addressing one to him; the proposed 'in the name of' restores the forged attribution.

Later, when there were those who slandered Guang, the emperor would always angrily say: 'The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, whom the late emperor entrusted to him. Anyone who dares to slander or defame him shall be punished.'

Later, when anyone slandered Guang, the emperor would always say angrily, 'The Grand General is a loyal minister of the state, entrusted with his charge by the late emperor. Anyone who dares slander him will be punished.'
先帝所屬 means that the late emperor entrusted Guang with his charge; this revision removes the wrong argument while completing the English construction naturally.
Edict said: I pity common people not satisfied, previous year reduced tribute three hundred ten thousand shi.
Edict said: I pity common people not satisfied, previous year reduced tribute three million shi.
Source 三百萬石 is three million shi; 'three hundred ten thousand' misreads the numeral.

Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezhi, holding an imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang.'

Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding an imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang.'
Source 傅介子 is Fu Jiezi; Jiezhi would require 介之, so the personal name must be corrected.

Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezhi, holding imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang."

Ping Le Supervisor Fu Jiezi, holding imperial tally as envoy, executed and beheaded King An of Loulan, returned and displayed the head at the north gate of the capital, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yiyang."
Source 介子 is Jiezi; the literal likewise mistranslates the personal name as Jiezhi.
In the twelfth month, on a Gengxu day, Chancellor Yin passed away.
In the twelfth month, on a Gengxu day, Chancellor Xin passed away.
Source 丞相訢 is Chancellor Xin; Yin would be 尹, so the idiomatic surname/given name must be Xin.
